### Do You Quickly Forget God’s Goodness? - Love Worth Finding - July 17
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-july-17-2024.html
Passage: Judges 8:33
Points:
- Immediately after Gideon died, Israel slid into ungrateful apostasy and turned to worshiping false gods.
- The people quickly forgot the astonishing victories and deliverances the Lord had worked on their behalf.
- Believers share the same fallen human tendency to lose sight of God's goodness and past faithfulness.
- Guarding against spiritual decline requires intentionality and asking the Holy Spirit to keep God's truths continually in mind.
